attachments.scope: Finite dual-solid common points, three noncollinear rays each, positive triangle distance. Not load, folding, friction or stability.

passages.scope: 9 finite static under-panel empty-space segments plus6 occupied-panel controls. Rounded frame edges can occlude projected joint gaps;8 such diagnostic probes are retained separately. No body passage, folding or continuous collision guarantee

originalSpriteEnvelopeClearance.method: sphere enclosing all four full raw Sprite quad corners from actual world scale/center; sphere-to-conservative-3D-pose-envelope distance; includes faint/transparent corners without cropping

meadowInstances.scope: every actual current meadow instance geometry AABB transformed by its actual instance and world matrix, expanded .018 in all axes; current finite matrices and authored animation allowance, no all-frame proof

shoreline.method: every actual dry-land boundary segment against entire screen XZ AABB

placement.limits: one fixed authored screen pose at one synthetic current-default-world site;30 finite rays on six flat contact pads,63 finite walkability samples and conservative envelope clearances. Not a continuous placement/stability/physical/body or all-camera-visibility guarantee
